test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are true for the recipients of the Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards?

1. Sonal Mansingh was elected as Fellow of Sangeet Natak Akademi in the year 2018.

2. Jatin Goswami was elected as Fellow of Sangeet Natak Akademi in the year 2018.

3. Radha Sridhar received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in the year 2018 for her contribution to Kathak.
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Both 1 and 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonal Mansingh** Renowned classical dancer and choreographer of** Bharatanatyam and Odissi dance forms.**
 
• Recipient of several prestigious awards, including the **Padma Bhushan (1988) Padma Vibhushan (2003), and Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1987.**
 
• **Jatin Goswami **is Acclaimed for his expertise in **Sattriya**, a traditional dance form of Assam.
 
• Awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2007, Padma Shri in 2009** for his dedication to the arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Radha Shridhar** is an Indian classical dancer and a prominent figure in the world of **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• The S**angeet Natak Akademi i**s India's national academy for music, dance, and drama
 
• Founded in **1952** by the Government of India to promote and preserve the rich heritage of the performing arts in India.
 
• It is an autonomous body under the **Ministry of Culture, Government of India.**
 
• The Akademi confers several prestigious awards, including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship **and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards.**
